hebrewText: וְ/אִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֔א וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/קָּהָ֑ל כִּי֩ אֶת מִקְדַּ֨שׁ יְהוָ֜ה טִמֵּ֗א מֵ֥י נִדָּ֛ה לֹא זֹרַ֥ק עָלָ֖י/ו טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: ish — homem, varão, marido, indivíduo, alguém
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)
tokens.kjv: defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, [idiom] utterly.
tokens.explanation: to be foul

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn
tokens.kjv: bear the blame, cleanse, commit (sin), by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend(-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin(-ful, -ness), trespass.
tokens.explanation: properly

tokens.bdb: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
tokens.kjv: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.
tokens.explanation: to cut (off

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.
tokens.explanation: nefesh — alma, ser vivo, vida, pessoa, desejo interior

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
tokens.kjv: among(-st), [idiom] between, half, [idiom] (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), [idiom] out (of), [idiom] through, [idiom] with(-in).
tokens.explanation: tavek — meio, centro, interior, entre

tokens.bdb: assemblage (usually concretely)
tokens.kjv: assembly, company, congregation, multitude.
tokens.explanation: assemblage

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum
tokens.kjv: chapel, hallowed part, holy place, sanctuary.
tokens.explanation: a consecrated thing or place

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)
tokens.kjv: defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, [idiom] utterly.
tokens.explanation: to be foul

tokens.bdb: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
tokens.kjv: [phrase] piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).
tokens.explanation: mayim — água, rio, mar (sempre plural em hebraico)

tokens.bdb: properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] far, filthiness, [idiom] flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, [idiom] removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness).
tokens.explanation: properly

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to sprinkle (fluid or solid particles)
tokens.kjv: be here and there, scatter, sprinkle, strew.
tokens.explanation: to sprinkle

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: foul in a religious sense
tokens.kjv: defiled, [phrase] infamous, polluted(-tion), unclean.
tokens.explanation: foul in a religious sense

tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
